title: Roster names each agent's next move and puts its one action on the row
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the approval clock reads pendingApprovalSince = ts of the newest agent_activity lifecycle row whose raw.transition moved INTO pending_approval FROM another status (self-moves such as a poll re-reading 'pending' excluded, else every poll would restart the 24h clock), never updated_at; with no such stamp, approve_in_personas carries hoursLeft:null and the row says 'Waiting for approval in Personas' with no countdown (and never approval_lapsed). lastDecision skips refused:* rows (a refusal is not a decision) and exposes only the event name (reason suffix stripped). A failed/rejected row with an unpaired bridge answers repair_bridge, not redispatch (redispatch cannot succeed without the bridge); retired is none even when unpaired. review_probation's control is Refresh (the review itself happens in Personas). Added NEXT_ACTION_TRANSITION + a case pinning each implied move against AGENT_TRANSITIONS (slot A's hand-off); redispatch implies none (dead hires have no exits; it mints a new row). The route case lives in a new app/api/agents/roster-next-move.test.ts (agents-bridge.test.ts is slot A's file and imports the db barrel). Grew the write set by perf-budget.json (lock) and that one new test file.
notes: Full test:unit exit 1, none of it this card's: offer-link-locale.test.ts BROKEN (sibling comms-dispatch-relay has uncommitted comms-dispatch.ts / stage-hooks.ts in the checkout), profiles-lineage and python-runner-concurrency FLAKE. All agents tests green (88/88 across agents-workforce, api/agents, db/agents*, agent-hire). tsc red only on foreign paths (app/_lib/pipeline-arrival-plan.test.ts - sibling in-flight; untracked kpi-sim/). test:perf on the shared checkout shows ~12 routes 3-4 KB over; measured on a git archive of HEAD with only this card's source files, every route is inside its ceiling (hire-from-need 3125/3130) - those overages are sibling uncommitted files (core.ts, pipeline.ts, comms-dispatch.ts). app/page.tsx grew +14 KB (no new module); raised 8939 -> 8941 KB (only the part that did not fit the headroom) in 76a3e470a with a why. Catalogs (agentsWorkforce.nextAction.*) and docs committed under the lock and released. Both themes: only tokens/recipes (CHIP_TOGGLE, BTN_SECONDARY, META_LABEL, PANEL, text-coral/ink/steel/moss); design:check green.
